### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-storage`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s).

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620`.

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `30fa568174a0eb29091256c61f9c98be015fc85e` — the merge of head `4e5caaddaa3c1c95575db0b4056c3cb99344ae3e` into base `e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 30fa568174a0eb29091256c61f9c98be015fc85e && git checkout 30fa568174a0eb29091256c61f9c98be015fc85e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620 4e5caaddaa3c1c95575db0b4056c3cb99344ae3e && git checkout -B drift-repro e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620 && git merge --no-ff 4e5caaddaa3c1c95575db0b4056c3cb99344ae3e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

review#2 (server area pilot, A3).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4e5caaddaa3c1c95575db0b4056c3cb99344ae3e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts, packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.test.ts, .changeset/33027-chunked-complete-retry.md + packages/client/src/index.ts (`resumeUpload`), packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts (read, not reviewed)

Face: narrowing (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on the changeset). Diff read against merge base `e540baf8`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Completion door: the new `live.status === 'completed'` branch sits after the uploader, starting-organization, expiry and `judgeCompletion` checks and before the `completing` write, so a retry is still refused 403/409/410 exactly where a first completion would be, and a retry that passes writes nothing and never calls the backend. The pin asserts both (`completeChunkedUpload` and `updateSession` spies not called).
- `expireIfPastDeadline` cannot turn a completed session into `expired` (`TERMINAL_SESSION_STATUSES` holds `completed`), so a retry after the deadline still answers the 200; no stamp is written over `completed`.
- Retry body: `completedUploadBody(session, file)` uses the committed file row's `key`, which the first completion wrote as `finalKey`, so the retry's body equals the first answer (pinned with `toEqual(first.data)`). The success path now builds its body through the same helper with `{ key: finalKey }`; same five fields, same values as before.
- Chunk door: the `completed` refusal comes after the resume token, the starting-organization gate and the expiry check, and before the index check, the backend `uploadChunk` and the progress write. Pinned: 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, no backend call, `parts` / `uploaded_size` unchanged. `in_progress`, `completing` and `failed` sessions are untouched (control test for in-flight).
- The SDK scenario the changeset names holds: `resumeUpload` on a completed session sends no chunk (all chunks already counted) and posts `complete` with an empty `parts` list, which `judgeCompletion` accepts against the session's record, so it now gets the 200 instead of a 500 and a `failed` stamp.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/service-storage`, BREAKING banner via the `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` line, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Right for a non-protocol narrowing: no authorable key, value or type moves, so `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No published schema (`packages/spec/src/**`) and no governed path in the diff. `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` is already this package's code for the incomplete-upload refusal, so no error-code ledger row is owed. `storage.zod.ts` declares no per-door status set for the chunk door, so the new 409 contradicts nothing published.
- Nit (does not block): a chunk with a malformed or out-of-range index sent to a completed session now answers 409 rather than 400, since the status check precedes the index check. Harmless, the upload is finished either way; not worth a change.
- Nit (does not block): if the committed file is later deleted, a retry of its completion still answers 200 with the file's URL (which then 404s on use). That is a retry of a completion that did succeed, so the answer is honest about the completion; follow-up only if someone hits it.
- All 56 check runs on this head completed: 36 success, 20 skipped, none failed. Mergeable state clean.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged against `storage.zod.ts` and `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx` on `main`: neither promises that a completed upload accepts further chunks, and the progress door already reports `completed` as terminal. The narrowing takes away nothing a consumer could rely on (a chunk stored after completion belonged to no file), and the widening makes completion idempotent, which is what the SDK's resume path assumes. Answering the retry from the stored rows rather than re-running the backend is the right shape: the backend multipart no longer exists, and the stored rows are the source of truth for what was committed. No must-fix or should-fix; two nits above, either can be left.
